record.question: There are 100 students in a hostel. Food provision for them is for 20 days. How long will these provisions last , if 25 more students join the group?
record.explanation: The food covers 100×20=2,000 student-days. With 125 students and the same daily allowance it lasts 2,000/125=16 days, option C. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
